_comment: Copy to manifest.json and drop matching 16 kHz mono WAV clips in this folder. Each case needs a wav plus a lineId (resolved from content/mutoon/tuhfat_al_atfal.json) or a raw expected string. Optional goldenWords: labeled ASR-drop words for that line (from a recite-log labels file) — the eval reports per-engine whether each was recovered. Run: npm --prefix app run asr:eval. For the FastConformer decision gate, set FASTCONFORMER_PY to the sidecar venv python (see scripts/fastconformer-sidecar.py).
